# `workspace_setup` — `/api/community`

Owner-applied workspace kits; additions and receipt commit together exactly once.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/workspace-setup`](#get-api-community-spaces-sid-workspace-setup) | Space owner | The workspace kits a space owner can stage, and those already staged in the space. |
| POST | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/workspace-setup`](#post-api-community-spaces-sid-workspace-setup) | Space owner | Stages a kit's folders, files and items in the space, once per kit (space owners). |
| POST | [`/api/community/spaces/{sid}/workspace-setup/preview`](#post-api-community-spaces-sid-workspace-setup-preview) | Space owner | What a kit would add, without adding it (space owners). |

<a id="get-api-community-spaces-sid-workspace-setup"></a>
### `GET /api/community/spaces/{sid}/workspace-setup`

The workspace kits a space owner can stage, and those already staged in the space.

- Handler: [`catalog`](../../../backend/community/workspace_setup.py)
- Who may call: Owners of the space

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sid` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `kits` (JSON list, each item JSON object with `kit`, `name`, `description`, `root`, `lists`, `items`, `notes`, `events`, `tasks`, `folders`, `files`, `spreadsheets`, `departments`, `trackers`), `installed` (JSON list of rows of `workspace_setups`: `kit`, `client`, `opening_date`, `created`)

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Space owner access required. | `membership` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 404 | Workspace kit not found. | `plan` |
| 422 | Choose an opening date with room for planning milestones. | `plan` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="post-api-community-spaces-sid-workspace-setup"></a>
### `POST /api/community/spaces/{sid}/workspace-setup`

Stages a kit's folders, files and items in the space, once per kit (space owners).

- Handler: [`apply`](../../../backend/community/workspace_setup.py)
- Who may call: Owners of the space

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sid` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `SetupBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kit` | string | yes |  |  |
| `client` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `opening_date` | string or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `201`: JSON object with `kit`, `name`, `description`, `root`, `lists`, `items`, `notes`, `events`, `tasks`, `folders`, `files`, `spreadsheets`, `departments`, `trackers`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Space owner access required. | `membership` |
| 404 | Space not found. | `membership` |
| 404 | Workspace kit not found. | `plan` |
| 409 | Choose a new space; this kit would exceed the workspace item limit. | `apply` |
| 409 | This kit has already been staged in this space. Your team’s edits are kept; use a new space for another edition. | `apply` |
| 409 | {root} already exists. Rename it or choose a new space before staging this kit. | `apply` |
| 413 | This space needs more storage before the kit can be staged. | `apply` |
| 422 | Choose an opening date with room for planning milestones. | `plan` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 507 | The server needs more free space. | `apply` |
